name: git-tracking
description: Shows the Git state of every project in a side pane: three levels (GitHub, PC, folders) from the reflog and a track plan of branches and commits, plus a fourth level with the releases and betas published on GitHub. Gives Claude a short Git summary when a conversation starts. In English and German.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: auto = system language, de = Deutsch, en = English. Can also be switched in the pane.

claudeSummary.title: Summary for Claude / Kurzfassung für Claude
claudeSummary.description: on = when a conversation starts, Claude gets a few lines about branches, worktrees and uncommitted or unpushed work (only when there is something to report). off = nothing is added.
